artefacts.effect: [GREY KNIGHTS only] Once per battle, teleport-dodge a ranged attack, redeploying more than 8" from enemy units.

artefacts.name: Banishing Wave
artefacts.effect: [GREY KNIGHTS only (Psychic)] Deep Strike trigger: roll D6 per nearby enemy unit; 2-5 = 1 mortal wound, 6 = D3 mortal wounds.

artefacts.name: Blinding Aura
artefacts.effect: [GREY KNIGHTS only] Deep Strike trigger: the bearer's unit is immune to Fire Overwatch that turn.

artefacts.name: Purity of Purpose
artefacts.effect: [GREY KNIGHTS only] Deep Strike trigger: re-roll Charge rolls for the bearer's unit that turn.

artefacts.name: Tome of Forbidden Ways
artefacts.effect: [GREY KNIGHTS only] Increases the number of units selectable for Gate of Infinity by 1.

artefacts.name: Eye of the Augurium
artefacts.effect: [GREY KNIGHTS only] Gain an extra Heroic Intervention use at -1CP.

artefacts.name: Inescapable Judgement
artefacts.effect: [GREY KNIGHTS only (Psychic)] When an enemy unit Falls Back from Engagement Range, it suffers D3 or D3+3 mortal wounds.

artefacts.name: Sanctic Reaper
artefacts.effect: [GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR only] Add 3 to the bearer's Attacks characteristic in melee.

artefacts.name: Nemesis Rounds
artefacts.effect: [GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR only] Fire Overwatch attacks made by the bearer's unit hit on an unmodified 5+.

artefacts.name: Sigil of the Hunt
artefacts.effect: [GREY KNIGHTS only] Re-roll Hit rolls of 1 in the Shooting phase for the bearer.

artefacts.name: The Ephemeral Tome
artefacts.effect: [GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY only] The bearer's unit can move D6" instead of shooting; it loses eligibility to charge that turn.

artefacts.name: The Sixty-sixth Seal
artefacts.effect: [GREY KNIGHTS only] Add 1 AP to the bearer's ranged attacks in the Shooting phase.

artefacts.name: Pyresoul
artefacts.effect: [GREY KNIGHTS only (Psychic)] Once per turn, inflict D3 mortal wounds on an enemy unit within 24".

artefacts.name: Driven by Duty
artefacts.effect: [GREY KNIGHTS WALKER only] The bearer can Pile-in and Consolidate up to 6".

artefacts.name: Quickening Foci
artefacts.effect: [GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY only] Re-roll Charge rolls after disembarking.

artefacts.name: Spiritus Machina
artefacts.effect: [GREY KNIGHTS INFANTRY only] Re-roll Wound rolls after disembarking and shooting.

artefacts.name: Grimoire of Conjunctions
artefacts.effect: [GREY KNIGHTS only] Once per battle, add 4 to the bearer's Strength characteristic in melee.

artefacts.name: Shield of Prophecy
artefacts.effect: [GREY KNIGHTS only] Once per battle, add 2 to the bearer's Toughness for the round.

artefacts.name: One Foot in the Future
artefacts.effect: [GREY KNIGHTS only] After an ingress move, move D6" further (loses charge eligibility that turn).

artefacts.name: Doomseer's Amulet
artefacts.effect: [GREY KNIGHTS only] On Reinforcements setup, force a nearby enemy unit to take a Battle-shock test at -1.

armyRules.name: Gate of Infinity
armyRules.effect: At the end of your opponent's Fight phase, select up to 2/3/4 eligible units (by battle size, all must have this ability and be outside Engagement Range) and place them into Strategic Reserves; they can make an ingress move in your next Movement phase, including turn 1.
